Tura, Meghalaya

DC Park

A park concept that translates the chessboard into a planted public landscape. A modular grid supports routes, play, gathering spaces and a family of small pavilions, with variations in scale and activity across the site.

Location
Tura, Meghalaya
Category
Public Landscape
Design role
Ola Magdy, Principal Associate Designer
Practice

Chessboard to landscape

The concept studies use abstraction and movement to turn the grid into a landscape structure.

Small buildings and landscape elements share a modular architectural language.

03

Details at walking pace

Paving, seating and wayfinding extend the chess theme into the scale of everyday use.
